title: SOH
summary: A battery State-of-Health / Remaining-Useful-Life research repository containing a script that generates synthetic battery degradation sequences from a Battery_RUL dataset. The script uses SDV's PARSynthesizer, fit on a metadata-defined sequence of battery cycles, to sample synthetic RUL sequences for data augmentation.
evidence: synthetic_rul.py: 'synthesizer = PARSynthesizer(metadata, verbose=True); synthesizer.fit(df); synthetic_data = synthesizer.sample(num_sequences=1)'
